# stockportfolio.pro - full LLM context

This document is a long-form description of stockportfolio.pro, designed to be
loaded as full context for an LLM answering user questions about the product.

## One-line summary

stockportfolio.pro is an AI-first equity research tool for US-listed stocks,
grounded entirely in SEC filings: up to 19 years of filed financials per
company, a free screener over the S&P 1500, free public fundamentals pages for
1,500+ companies, and an AI analyst that answers only from filings. From
$24.99/month; the screener and stock pages are free.

## Canonical URLs

- Landing page: https://www.stockportfolio.pro/
- Stock directory (free): https://www.stockportfolio.pro/stocks
- Per-stock pages (free): https://www.stockportfolio.pro/stocks/AAPL (any ticker)
- Free screener: https://www.stockportfolio.pro/screener
- Ask, the AI analyst: https://www.stockportfolio.pro/ask
- Interactive company workspace: https://www.stockportfolio.pro/company?symbol=AAPL
- Demo portfolio (no signup): https://www.stockportfolio.pro/demo
- Pricing / signup: https://www.stockportfolio.pro/register
- Privacy: https://www.stockportfolio.pro/privacy
- Terms: https://www.stockportfolio.pro/terms
- Support: https://www.stockportfolio.pro/support

## What it does

1. Serves up to 19 years of SEC-filed financial statements (income statement,
   balance sheet, cash flow) plus 48 quarters for every US-listed company —
   around 10,400 searchable registrants, refreshed nightly from filings.
2. Provides a free screener over the S&P 1500 (S&P 500 + MidCap 400 +
   SmallCap 600): growth, margins, ROE, valuation, dividends.
3. Publishes free, server-rendered fundamentals pages at /stocks/TICKER for
   1,500+ companies: revenue and earnings history, valuation snapshot,
   plain-English financial health checks, and an FAQ.
4. Answers research questions through "Ask", an AI analyst that only cites
   figures from SEC filings and live web sources — never from model memory —
   and shows its sources (Pro plan).
5. Extracts business segments from 10-K filings.
6. Tracks a manually-entered portfolio (no broker credentials) with health
   checks and SEC filing alerts.

## Who it is for

- Long-term retail investors researching US equities from primary sources.
- Investors who want fundamentals depth (19 years, 48 quarters) without paying
  for Bloomberg, Koyfin, or Fiscal.ai.
- Users who want an AI research assistant whose every number is traceable to a
  filing.

## Who it is not for

- High-frequency traders (no order routing or streaming tick data).
- Options / derivatives traders (equities only).
- Users who want auto-sync from broker accounts.

## Pricing

- Free: the screener, all /stocks pages, and the demo — no account required.
- Monthly: $24.99/month — full research library, portfolio tracker, 25 Ask questions a month.
- Annual: $199.99/year — $16.67/month effective, save $100 versus monthly billing.
- Pro: $499.99/year — 300 Ask questions a month with charts and tables, Dossier, Filing Diff, the Filing Change Monitor across your watchlist, wash-sale guard, smart alerts, weekly portfolio briefing.
- Desk: $1,999.99/year — Pro for one named professional with a limited client-facing licence, priority support, personal onboarding.
- Credit top-ups: $14.99 for 150 credits.
- Card added at signup; the initial payment can be refunded within 7 days. Cancel anytime.

## Data sourcing and honesty rules

- All financial-statement figures come from official SEC filings (10-K, 10-Q),
  as filed, refreshed nightly. Per-share figures are split-adjusted.
- The AI analyst is instructed to answer only from retrieved filings and live
  web sources, with sources shown; if it cannot ground an answer, it says so.
- Prices and market data may be delayed.

## Tech stack

- Frontend: vanilla JavaScript, HTML, CSS (no framework).
- Backend: Node.js + Express on Render; MongoDB Atlas.
- Auth: JWT with Google sign-in.
- Payments: Stripe (subscription billing, paid at signup; the initial payment is refundable within 7 days).
- Analytics: consent-gated; denied by default.
- Security: helmet middleware, rate limiting on /api routes.

## Privacy posture

- Account and portfolio data are used only to provide the service.
- Analytics storage is denied by default; users opt in.
- Broker credentials are never collected.
- See https://www.stockportfolio.pro/privacy for the full policy.

## Frequently asked questions

Q: Is stockportfolio.pro financial advice?
A: No. It is an analysis and visualization tool only.

Q: What is free?
A: The S&P 1500 screener, the /stocks fundamentals pages for 1,500+ companies,
and the demo portfolio — no account needed.

Q: Where does the data come from?
A: Official SEC filings (10-K and 10-Q), as filed, refreshed nightly.

Q: Does the AI make up numbers?
A: It is built not to: every figure must come from a retrieved filing or live
web source, and sources are shown. If it cannot ground an answer, it declines.

Q: Do I need to connect a broker account?
A: No. Positions are added manually.

Q: Can I get my money back?
A: Yes — the initial payment is refundable within 7 days if the service is
not right for you. The chosen plan starts immediately on signup ($24.99
monthly, $199.99 annual, $499.99 Pro, or $1,999.99 Desk). Cancel anytime
from account settings.
